laws.rule: In scenic areas, carving or scribbling on scenery and facilities, and littering, are banned (article 19). The management body orders the damage to be repaired. Deliberate damage to protected heritage is dealt with under the Public Security Administration Punishments Law, and serious cases can be criminal (article 38). The regulation came into force on 15 August 2026.
laws.penalty_signal: Carving, scribbling or littering: CNY 50 (about A$10.67). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 河北省风景名胜区条例 (Hebei Province Scenic Areas Regulation)

laws.rule: Electric bicycle riders may not ride the wrong way, race, ride on expressways or in restricted zones, or smoke, eat or use a phone while riding (article 43). Riders and passengers should wear a helmet (article 44). Parking or charging an e-bike in building lobbies, stairwells, exits or crowded places, or inside homes, dormitories or offices, is banned (article 46).
laws.penalty_signal: Riding offences: warning or CNY 10 to 50 (about A$2.13 to A$10.67) (article 43). Indoor charging or parking: up to CNY 500 (about A$107) for an individual (article 46). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
